definitions.gloss: tea ceremony, the way of tea
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of preparing and serving matcha tea with prescribed rituals and etiquette.

examples.japanese: {茶道|さどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{体験|たいけん}した→体験する：11443_taiken⟧。
{茶道|さどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}ぶ→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{茶道|さどう}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{通|かよ}っている→通う：01217_kayou⟧。
examples.english: I attend a tea ceremony class in Kyoto.

notes:
COMPOUND: {茶|さ} (tea) + {道|どう} (way, path)

ALTERNATE READINGS:
- {茶道|ちゃどう} - also correct

MAJOR SCHOOLS:
- ⟦{裏千家|うらせんけ}→裏千家：noentry⟧ (Urasenke - largest)
- ⟦{表千家|おもてせんけ}→表千家：noentry⟧ (Omotesenke)
- ⟦{武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ}→武者小路千家：noentry⟧ (Mushakōji-senke)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {茶道|さどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧ (to learn tea ceremony)
- {茶道|さどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作法|さほう}→作法：02825_sahou⟧ (tea ceremony etiquette)
- {茶道|さどう}⟦{教室|きょうしつ}→教室：00794_kyoushitsu⟧ (tea ceremony class)
- ⟦お{点前|てまえ}→お点前：18178_otemae⟧ (the act of making tea)
- ⟦{茶室|ちゃしつ}→茶室：14081_chashitsu⟧ (tea room)

KEY TERMS:
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧ (matcha, powdered green tea)
- ⟦{茶碗|ちゃわん}→茶碗：01019_chawan⟧ (tea bowl)
- ⟦{茶筅|ちゃせん}→茶筅：23829_chasen⟧ (bamboo whisk)
- ⟦{和敬清寂|わけいせいじゃく}→和敬清寂：noentry⟧ (harmony, respect, purity, tranquility - the four principles)
